end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Government / Indian Railways and affiliated GoI entities (82.01% of revenue from operations, FY2026 consolidated; 81.50% FY2025; 67.74% FY2024)
- Non-Government clients - civil contractors, rolling stock manufacturers, OEMs and regular suppliers to Indian Railways (17.99% of revenue from operations, FY2026 consolidated; 18.50% FY2025; 32.26% FY2024)

certifications.title: Certs (RHP)
certifications.body:
- ISO 9001:2015
- Approved supplier registrations with various professional directorates of the Ministry of Railways, including the Research Designs & Standards Organisation (RDSO)

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: The Company procures raw materials and components, undertakes in-house manufacturing and value-addition processes, and supplies finished or value-added products to its customers; the Contract Division separately undertakes execution of turnkey electrification contracts (design, supply, erection, testing and commissioning) forming part of the Company's service operations. Manufacturing follows an in-house sequence from Bill of Materials presentation through vendor-sourced procurement, incoming quality check, stage-wise assembly/testing, to final dispatch after mandatory Third-Party Inspection (TPI) by Indian Railways.

demand_drivers.title: Seasonality (RHP report)
demand_drivers.body: Our business does not depend to a certain extent on the seasonal, environmental and climate changes.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body: - A significant and rising share of revenue (67.74% FY24 to 82.01% FY26, consolidated) comes from government/GoI entities; reduced railway-sector spending, adverse procurement policy changes, tender delays or inability to maintain historical business levels with Indian Railways may materially and adversely affect business, financial condition and results of operations.

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Company intends to utilize Rs. 3,360.00 lakhs of the Fresh Issue proceeds towards funding the working capital requirements of the Company.**
- **Amount utilized for general corporate purposes from Issue proceeds shall not exceed 15% of the amount raised by the Company or Rs. 10 Crores, whichever is lower.**
- **Company believes listing on the Emerge Platform of NSE will enhance its corporate image, brand name and create a public market for its Equity Shares in India.**
- **Company's stated vision is to strive to be best in its class by offering state-of-the-art products with regard to standard of workmanship, secure working procedures, practices and policies.**
- **Company's stated mission is to provide the highest quality services exceeding customer expectations through its broad spectrum of designing, manufacturing and developing.**
